about.text: New global stats database ('The site and app just launched'): builds, runes, counters, tier lists, matchups, synergies, one-tricks, top players and pro data built from ~15.6 million ranked games with the games count shown behind each number; Windows desktop app with in-game overlay; forum and Discord.

pricing.text: Free website and desktop app; a 'Premium' page is linked in the footer (terms not read)

languages.text: 18 languages in the selector: English, Korean, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Vietnamese, Thai, Czech, Greek, Dutch

coverage.text: 15,625,663 ranked games; 173 champions; ARAM and 26 data explorers
